fusions.name: Chill Flick
fusions.desc: A flicking strike on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stilled in Place
fusions.desc: Breathes a chill cone 3 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sun on the Flank
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you, with a 10% chance to heal critically. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Calm at Full Strength
fusions.desc: While you are at full health, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
